description: This file defines the SmartView class, including related functions and constants, for handling smart views within the application. It manages properties such as title, icon, and predicate, and includes utility functions to identify system views and smart views.

classes.name: SmartView
classes.description: Represents a smart view item that includes properties like title, icon, and predicate. Extends DecryptedItem to include specific content and functionality for smart views.

methods.name: export function isSystemView(view: SmartView): boolean { isSystemView
methods.description: Checks if a given SmartView instance corresponds to a system-defined view based on its uuid.

methods.name: isSmartView
methods.description: Type guard function that determines if an ItemInterface object is a SmartView based on its content_type.

ctags.name: isSmartView
ctags.pattern: /^export const isSmartView = (x: ItemInterface): x is SmartView => x.content_type === ContentType./
